definitions.nominal_cron_delivery_ratio: Observed natural schedule roots divided by current cron expressions expanded over the window. It is not an SLA or capacity measurement.
definitions.content_digest_gate: Application-level integrity gate, reported separately from GitHub schedule delivery.
definitions.run_success: Conclusion of attempt 1 for event=schedule only.
definitions.public_get: Independent anonymous HTTP GET resolving a public surface.
definitions.crawler_index: Crawler/index receipts are separate from HTTP delivery; IndexNow acceptance is not index presence.
definitions.click: Measured click evidence; post visibility is not a click.
definitions.asc_download: App Store Connect sales-report first-download evidence.
definitions.sales_trends_window: Each metric carries its own start, end, metric, known, unknown and denominator fields. Daily, rolling 7d and MTD windows are not interchangeable.
definitions.sales_trends_unknown: A missing MTD report row is unknown, not zero. Sales and Trends aggregates are exact and do not use Analytics privacy suppression.
